run_do_fft: run a fast Fourier transform on a time-domain signal and return frequency values and magnitude
run_filter_impulse_response: run a filter impulse response calculation given SOS or FIR coefficients and sample count
run_filter_freq_response: run a frequency response analysis on an IIR filter specified in second order sections
run_filter_phase_delay: run a phase delay calculation on an IIR filter and return delay as a function of frequency
run_filter_group_delay: run a group delay calculation on an IIR or FIR filter using the Lyons method
